sources: https://kingscampground.org/reservations/ (Cloudflare refuses plain HTTP; read in the headless browser)

values.note: 'One daily rate for any site': 2025 site rental $45 a night for up to 4 people, +$5 per extra person (maximum 6); $560 a month plus electric. Overnight stops pay by check, money order or cash; credit card, PayPal or Venmo for longer stays.

fees.source: https://kingscampground.org/reservations/ ('2025 Site Rental Per Night - $45.00'), read 2026-10-20

hookups.source: https://kingscampground.org/reservations/ ('pull-thru sites, water, electricity and a dump station'), read 2026-10-20

sites.source: https://kingscampground.org/amenities/ ('54 Campsites') + https://kingscampground.org/reservations/ ('long Pull-thru RV sites'), read 2026-10-20

facilities.source: https://kingscampground.org/amenities/ ('Wi-Fi', 'Camp Store', 'Dump Station', 'HEATED BATHHOUSE') + reservations page ('a dump station'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: 'Please call 717-460-5119.' On arrival, call the campground hosts, who escort you to the site.

summary: Confirmed the 2025 $45 one-rate-for-any-site price, water, 54 sites with long pull-throughs, dump station and phone booking; added camp store and WiFi. Not stated on the pages read: amperage (50 stays note-derived), sewer, season, showers (the page says only 'heated bathhouse').
flags: Incidental, outside this batch: SC entry 4375 'King's RV Park Campground' (Belton SC, phone 864-314-1023) has this PA campground's site https://kingscampground.org/reservations/ as its website; that URL belongs to King's Campground, Dillsburg PA.
